project_context: Buddilio - Consumer social/events marketplace + Admin Console
design_philosophy: Elevated Editorial & Soft Utility. The brand identity shifts away from 'overwhelming pink' to a sophisticated, high-contrast neutral base where magenta and pink act purely as high-impact accents. The UI must feel spacious, authoritative, and modern. Admin panels shift from cluttered tabs to a strictly organized, focused sidebar structure.

font_pairing.headings: Cabinet Grotesk (replaces Outfit) - Provides a punchy, editorial, and modern feel without being generic.
font_pairing.body: Satoshi (replaces Manrope) - Clean, highly legible, modern geometric sans that works beautifully for dense admin data.

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-bud-ink leading-tight
hierarchy_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-bud-ink leading-snug

colors.strategy: Dial back the pink. The background and surface colors must be neutral, airy, and professional. Pink/Magenta are reserved EXCLUSIVELY for primary buttons, active sidebar states, and brand moments.

usage.backgrounds: Use --bud-bg for main app backgrounds and --bud-surface (white) for cards, sidebars, and content areas.
usage.text: Never use pure black. Use --bud-ink for headings and primary text, --bud-muted for secondary text.
usage.accents: Use --bud-magenta for primary CTAs and active states. Use --bud-coral for warnings or secondary highlights.

header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full h-20 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-bud-line px-6 lg:px-12 flex items-center justify-between
header.spacing: Generous internal padding. Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur.
header.mobile: Bottom tab bar (`fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-bud-line pb-safe pt-2`) for Home, Discover, Events, Chat, You.

footer.structure: Grid layout. Top section: Logo + Tagline (left), 3 link groups (right). Bottom section: City marquee (slow scrolling ribbon in text-bud-muted), Legal line, Social icons.
footer.typography: Links should be text-sm text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors.

auth_page.left_panel: White background (`bg-white`), content perfectly centered with generous padding (`p-12 lg:p-24`). Form max-width `max-w-md`.
auth_page.right_panel: Brand imagery/lifestyle photo with a subtle gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-t from-bud-ink/50 to-transparent`). Never a flat pink block.
auth_page.21_gate_messaging: Styled as a distinct, trust-building badge above the form: `inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-bud-bg border border-bud-line px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-bud-ink mb-8`.

admin_console.layout: Desktop: `grid lg:grid-cols-[260px_1fr] min-h-screen`. Mobile: Collapsible drawer for sidebar.
admin_console.sidebar_classes: bg-[#FAFAFA] border-r border-bud-line h-screen sticky top-0 overflow-y-auto p-6 flex flex-col gap-8
admin_console.active_state: Do NOT use solid pink blocks for active tabs. Use: `bg-pink-50 text-bud-magenta font-semibold rounded-lg` with a subtle pink dot or line indicator.

buttons.primary: bg-bud-magenta text-white font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-bud-magenta/25 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-bud-bg text-bud-ink border border-bud-line font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-bud-line/50 transition-all

cards_and_tables.style: Flat, sharp, border-driven. No muddy shadows.
cards_and_tables.table_headers: bg-[#FAFAFA] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-bud-muted font-bold py-4 px-6 border-b border-bud-line

functionality_fixes.membership_pricing_bug: CRITICAL TASK FOR MAIN AGENT: The user reported 'I changed the price in backend but it is not getting updated on website content section'. You MUST trace the data fetching logic for the membership section on the frontend and ensure it correctly binds to the backend database/API endpoint instead of relying on hardcoded or heavily cached data.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: Every interactive element MUST retain or be assigned a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `dash-tile-*`, `ledger-export`, `forgot-link`). Do not remove any existing test IDs.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text over images uses proper text-shadow or gradient overlays to maintain 4.5:1 contrast.
